proposal.reason: Main functional change is review/merge workflow policy and automation: reviewer routing, required approval gate semantics, invitation lifecycle, and squash-preview publication were reworked in .github/scripts/review_automation.py, .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py, .github/scripts/commit_message_squash.py plus new/renamed review-* workflows. Other edits (docs, skill text, roster wording) support this same workflow behavior rather than introducing an independent module scope.
